A mysterious '''representative''' of the "Far Outsiders,"<ref name="TUR" /> the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Species/Legends|species]],<ref name="TERC" /> made contact with the [[Miskara|ruler]] of the [[Vagaari Empire]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]], its [[Unidentified Miskara (Yuuzhan Vong)|Miskara]], by [[23 ABY/Legends|23 ABY]]. In exchange for the [[Vagaari/Legends|Vagaari]] help in the Yuuzhan Vong [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invasion]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], the Vagaari began incorporating the Yuuzhan Vong [[biot]]echnology.<ref name="TUR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Yuuzhan Vong representative was introduced in the [[2010]] sourcebook ''[[The Unknown Regions]]'', published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="TUR" />
